sources.title: Seed2.1 official model page
sources.evidence: Names Pro and Turbo as the two Seed2.1 variants, reports Turbo-specific reasoning/image/video benchmark results, and links directly to the Turbo ModelArk API and model card.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Officially Released: Advancing AI Productivity
sources.evidence: Dated 2026-06-23; announces Seed2.1 and says Doubao and Volcano Engine users can start access. Establishes initial family release rather than a later API revision or regional rollout.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Downloaded the complete 69 MB first-party PDF in memory and extracted its 73 pages after the web reader rejected its size. Page 1 introduces Turbo and Pro. Turbo appears in capability comparison tables. No production-model parameter counts or neural architecture are disclosed; parameter/architecture matches concern coding case studies or the Deep Think agent pipeline.

sources.title: ModelArk model list
sources.evidence: Read current complete MDContent from the page HTML router data (page updated October 23, 2026). Exact dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628 row: deep reasoning Yes, visual understanding Yes, audio understanding No; nominal 256K context/input/output/CoT; function calling Yes and MCP Yes. Lists the developer as ByteDance.

sources.title: Volcano Engine Ark model list
sources.evidence: Read current complete embedded MDContent after web timeout. Exact doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628 remains at nominal 256k context with text generation, multimodal understanding, reasoning and tool calling. The same current table separately lists newer 260915 Pro/Lite at 1024k, so their longer context is not transferred to Turbo.

sources.title: ModelArk quick start
sources.evidence: Official examples for exact dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628 accept text and image input, return output_text, show thinking control and tool requests. Current embedded page content was also retrieved directly.

sources.title: Video understanding
sources.evidence: Indexed official documentation provides video-understanding and equivalent timestamped image-frame request examples explicitly using dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628. This is exact-variant evidence for video input.

sources.title: Service Specific Terms — ModelArk and Model Services
sources.evidence: Read current embedded MDContent. Defines BytePlus Model Services as API services developed or owned by BytePlus or affiliates and grants a limited, revocable, non-transferable service license. Supports proprietary service classification; it is not a weight-distribution license.

sources.title: Seed2.1 official launch (Chinese)
sources.evidence: Dated June 23, 2026, explicitly directs users to select Doubao-Seed-2.1-Pro or Doubao-Seed-2.1-Turbo in TRAE and Ark; establishes Turbo availability at the original launch.

name.note: Official typography is Seed2.1 Turbo; catalog spacing is a faithful display normalization.

developer.note: Model card is authored by ByteDance Seed; provider row explicitly identifies ByteDance.

family.note: Explicitly belongs to the Seed family and Seed2.1 generation.

release_date.note: Initial Seed2.1 release introducing Turbo and Pro. The 260628 API identifier and later BytePlus/plan rollout are revision or availability dates, not the initial release date.

open_weights.note: Documented release is a hosted proprietary model service. Official release/card provides API access and no distributed Turbo checkpoint or open-weight license.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted ByteDance/BytePlus model service under limited service terms, not an SPDX license or claim that a checkpoint license was published.

parameters_b.note: The complete first-party model card and current later API comparison tables do not disclose Turbo total parameters. Searches for later exact-name technical/model-card and training/interpretability disclosures found no additional first-party count; no sibling topology is inferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact Turbo active-parameter count in the complete model card or current later first-party tables. Architecture is not disclosed, so no dense-model equivalence or MoE estimate is assumed.

architecture.note: No exact Turbo neural architecture disclosure located in the model card or later official sources, including targeted training/interpretability searches. Model-card architecture text concerns software or the Deep Think agent pipeline, not production neural layers.

context_window.note: Nominal normalization of the documented 256K/256k, not verification of an exact 256000-token ceiling. Current Turbo remains the 260628 revision; newer 1024k Pro/Lite rows are distinct. No exact integer is documented in the inspected Turbo sources.

modalities.note: Exact Turbo examples establish text/image/video input and text output. The current capability table explicitly marks audio understanding No, so no audio is added.

reasoning.note: Exact Turbo capability table marks deep reasoning Yes and official examples expose thinking control.

tool_call.note: Current exact Turbo tables explicitly confirm function calling and tool use; BytePlus also marks MCP support Yes.

description.value: ByteDance Seed 2.1 model for multimodal reasoning, coding, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces baseline comparative speed and latency positioning with documented capabilities.

patch.description: ByteDance Seed 2.1 model for multimodal reasoning, coding, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Context is documented as nominal 256K; 256000 is a display normalization, not an independently documented exact token ceiling. Current first-party Turbo specifications refer to doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628 / dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628. The 2026-06-23 date is the initial Seed2.1 launch; 260628 identifies the later API revision. Total parameters, active parameters, and neural architecture are undisclosed in the reviewed first-party sources. Audio understanding is explicitly unsupported in the current BytePlus Turbo table.

summary: Confirmed initial June 23 release and current 260628 Turbo capabilities: nominal 256K, text/image/video input, text output, reasoning and tools; audio is explicitly No. Added proprietary service classification and replaced comparative marketing description with plain capabilities. Complete model card plus later current first-party tables leave total/active parameters and neural architecture undisclosed. Current 1024k Seed2.1 Pro/Lite specifications do not apply to Turbo.
